name: jamal-pos-workspace
description: Jamal Café & Bakery POS System Workspace

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const cmd = (process.env.RENDER || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') ? 'npm --prefix frontend ci --omit=dev' : 'npm --prefix frontend install'; execSync(cmd, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
